format.about: The file's version; a change that renames or drops a field is a new format. A reader that does not know the format uses no preset and says so once.

name.about: Lower-case words joined with _; equal to the file name without .json.

about.about: One sentence: what it is for.

radius.about: The corner in px. 16 at most: a pill clips a two-line tip's text at the corners.

font.about: A CSS font-family stack of system and generic families; no web font is loaded. Left out: the page's body font.

size.about: A multiplier of the page's label size, never below 12 px.

delay.about: Milliseconds a pointer or focus rests before a hint shows. A disabled item's reason stays immediate.

light.about: The colours and shadow when the item's mode is light.

dark.about: The colours and shadow when the item's mode is dark.

arrow.about: Whether a tip in this look has an arrow (a card-style look may turn it off). Left out: on. A true here changes nothing; a false turns it off for the items the preset dresses, even where the page asks for an arrow.

bg.about: The fill; opaque #rrggbb so it can be checked alone.

line.about: The border of a pinned tip.

code_bg.about: Behind code. Left out: the ink at 12% over the fill.

shadow.about: A box-shadow, or none. Left out in dark: light's.

pairs.about: Field labels: the ink mixed 78% over the fill.
Code in a tip; with no code_bg, the ink at 12% over the fill.
The pinned tip's border, a non-text mark.

state.about: What happened to the element's tip: pinned, closed, or updated (a pinned tip was drawn again because its content changed, by "data", at most once per animation frame; the tip stays pinned).

id.about: The element's data-<prefix>-tip-id, else its id, as text.

kind.about: The element's data-<prefix>-tip-kind, else the default kind.

ids.about: The ids pinned after this event: [id] after a pin, [] after a close.

reason.about: Why it closed: the same element again, Escape, the close button, a click away, another pin, the element left the page, a layer around it closed (not sent by this build), a host command closed it (not sent by this build), or the tip was drawn again with another set of host slots ("redraw", by "data": a "pinned" follows at once); null on a pin.

text.about: The tip's plain words, cut at 200 characters with an ellipsis added.

by.about: Who caused it: "reader"; "data" for a "gone" close when the element left the page; "host" when a host command pinned, closed or hid the tip (not sent by this build).

from.about: The id pinned before this step, or null.

via.about: How it was done: "click" or "key" by the reader, "command" by a host command; null when by is "data".

slots.about: The ids of the host slots in this tip, as text, in the order drawn: [] when the tip has none. A host binds into [data-<prefix>-host="<id>"] on "pinned" and unbinds on "closed", which names the slots the tip had (so a redraw that changes the set sends "closed" with the old slots, then "pinned" with the new).

id.about: The element whose tip holds the code.

field.about: The record field the code came from.

block.about: The code block's place among the tip's code blocks, from 0.

ok.about: true when the browser let the copy happen.
